name: paranoidal-space-age-filter
title: Paranoidal Space Age Filter
author: FactorioParanoidal
description: Space Age for Paranoidal: the classic build up to the rocket, the planets after it. The other mods do not see the expansion, its changes to the base game are undone; after the rocket the space platforms, the planets Vulcanus, Fulgora, Gleba and Aquilo and the third-party planets of the build (Secretas and Frozeta), every planet with its own materials (not shared with the home tungsten, lithium, ammonia and scrap); victory at the solar system edge; space science made on a platform, no satellite. Does nothing without Space Age.
